questions.article: A survey was conducted in Madison to estimate the percent of adult residents who support the addition of a gas station at a popular intersection in their town. Based on the survey, it is estimated that 27% of all adult residents of Madison support the addition of a gas station at a popular intersection in their town, with an associated margin of error of 6%. Which of the following is the most appropriate conclusion about all adult residents of Madison?

options.name: A
options.content: Plausible values for the percent of all adult residents of Madison who support the addition of a gas station at a popular intersection in their town are between 21% and 33%.

options.name: B
options.content: Plausible values for the percent of all adult residents of Madison who support the addition of a gas station at a popular intersection in their town are either less than 21% or more than 33%.

options.name: C
options.content: The addition of a gas station at a popular intersection in the town is supported by exactly 21% of all adult residents of Madison.

options.name: D
options.content: The addition of a gas station at a popular intersection in the town is supported by more than 33% of all adult residents of Madison.

questions.correct: Plausible values for the percent of all adult residents of Madison who support the addition of a gas station at a popular intersection in their town are between 21% and 33%.
